body.purpose: Default native widget text and buttons.

emphasis.purpose: Joint headings and current angle values.

coordinate.purpose: Prominent mint X, Y, and Z values in millimetres.

matrix.purpose: Right-aligned, nonwrapping numeric tool-to-world matrix cells.

solution.purpose: Compact branch and B/S/E angle list.

motion.name: robot-joint-smoothstep
motion.purpose: Functional bounded joint-space motion only; no decorative shell animation.
motion.duration: max(1.0 seconds, 1.5 * largest absolute joint change / peak speed)
motion.completion: Assign exact target tuple; zero-distance move completes immediately.

nativeQt.units: Qt stylesheet and layout logical pixels; renderer caption font_size is a PyVista setting.

layout.fixedTransport: Below scrollable joint/IK body; 12px margins, 8px spacing, top divider; viewport/results composition preserved.

nativeQt.previewPolicy: Native widgets are documented without HTML/CSS translations. No browser runtime or web breakpoints apply.
nativeQt.palettePolicy: Frontmatter records implemented colors. No synthesized tonal ramps are used by the native application.
nativeQt.interaction: Immediate native shell feedback without decorative transitions; functional smoothstep joint-space robot motion.

sliders.valueLabels: Right-aligned degrees up to three decimals with trailing zeros removed; thumbs show nearest whole degree. Moving one slider preserves the other exact angles.

armRendering.shading: Phong, smooth shading with split sharp edges
armRendering.endpoint: Gold sphere centered at the mathematical endpoint; collar ends there.

resetBehavior.arm: Cancel motion immediately; restore [0, 45, -90] degrees and Idle at 0%; clear IK solutions, positioning feedback, and target marker; retain target text and camera.
resetBehavior.view: Restore initial perspective camera and preserve joint pose.

results.numericFormatting: Coordinates and matrix: three decimals; rounded negative zero becomes 0.000. Angle summary: up to three decimals with trailing zeros removed.
results.accessibility: Coordinate and matrix cells support mouse text selection and have axis or row/column accessible names.
results.clipboard: Copy results exports current joint angles, world-frame endpoint coordinates, and the tool-to-world homogeneous transform regardless of selected tab; native status bar confirms copy.
results.refresh: Joint changes, Apply now, every motion update, and Reset arm refresh both pages from shared FK; camera changes preserve results and active motion.

inverseKinematics.switchMode: Preserve active or paused motion and shared pose; live FK results remain available.

targetFields.acceptedText: Finite decimal and scientific notation, with a decimal point.
targetFields.validation: Mark all invalid fields, name axes in wrapping error text, focus first invalid field; editing clears its invalid border.

solutionList.selectionCounter: Selected solution n of total; branch tooltip; No solution selected when empty.

inverseKinematics.workflow: Calculate without moving; inspect/select valid branch; adjacent Apply now applies exact angles immediately; Animate moves to exact angles. Both disabled without selection.
inverseKinematics.invalidation: Editing or recalculating a target cancels active/paused motion, clears solutions/error, disables both solution actions, and hides marker until Calculate. Manual joint changes cancel motion, retain solutions, and refresh error.
inverseKinematics.failure: Invalid input and calculation failures preserve pose; finite parsed targets retain marker even if unreachable. Wrapping coral error messages distinguish invalid input, reach, joint-limit, and FK-validation failures with recovery guidance.
inverseKinematics.positioningError: Mint label showing current Euclidean endpoint-to-target error to nine decimals in mm; successful calculations include relevant singularity/boundary notes.

messages.recovery: Wrapping text explains invalid input, reach, limits, or validation failure; color is supplementary.

targetMarker.behavior: Centered on finite parsed target after Calculate; hidden on target edits or Reset arm; never resets camera.

motionTransport.placement: Fixed below scrollable sidebar body in both modes
motionTransport.progress: Integer active-elapsed-time percentage; textless 6px QProgressBar with 3px corners; divider track and arm-accent fill.
motionTransport.controls: Pause changes to Resume while paused; Pause/Resume and Stop enabled only while active/paused. Speed disabled while active/paused; Reset arm always immediate.
motionTransport.combo: Native QComboBox; placeholder surface, text foreground, 1px control-border, 4px radius, 5px padding; accent focus, text-disabled foreground, button-hover popup selection.
motionTransport.stop: Sample and hold current interpolated pose; retain Cancelled progress.
motionTransport.replace: Sample current pose and start selected replacement; selection alone does not move.
motionTransport.preserveMotion: Mode/result-tab changes, clipboard export, and camera controls.
motionTransport.instantOverride: Active/paused override reports Cancelled; direct pose after terminal/inactive motion returns Idle at 0%, clearing stale terminal progress.

keyboard.targetEnter: Calculate without moving; focus solution list on success.

target.name: IK demonstration
target.derivation: Shared FK through an isolated temporary RobotModel with the same geometry; current pose unchanged.

presets.load: Interrupt active/paused motion. Poses open FK joints and clear stale IK; target prepares inputs and opens IK target. Retain camera.

branding.name: RoboKin3D
branding.icon: Original simplified robotic arm; brand-navy ground, arm-accent links, accent joint rings, branding-base support, endpoint gold. Native window and taskbar identity.
branding.scope: Application icon and startup splash only; preserve incumbent workspace tokens and UI.

splash.status: Muted initialization status; ready workspace owns dismissal, without artificial delay.
splash.progress: Five-pixel indeterminate bar; arm-bearing track and arm-accent fill.
splash.effects: Flat surface; no shadows, glow, or decorative animation.
splash.rendering: Paint pixmap at screen device pixel ratio while retaining logical layout.

components.name: Reset arm

components.name: Joint sliders

components.name: Forward-kinematics results

components.name: Arm viewport

components.name: IK target fields

components.name: IK solution list

components.description: Calculate without moving; inspect/select valid branch; Apply now cancels motion and applies exact angles; Animate animates to exact angles. Both solution actions disabled without selection.

components.name: Motion transport
components.description: Fixed native speed selector, state/percentage, slim progress, Pause/Resume, Stop, and shared immediate Reset arm; details in extensions.nativeQt.motionTransport.

components.description: Native compact combo plus Load and pose/target hint; four immediate pose presets and one FK-derived target preparation. Details in extensions.nativeQt.presets.

components.name: Application icon and startup splash

narrative.overview:
A professional dark desktop workspace gives the rendered scene the most space and visual attention. Native Qt widgets provide readable controls, organized supporting information, and clear status feedback. The shell stays quiet and never imitates a physical instrument panel.

This document records the implemented Phase 6 forward- and inverse-kinematics workspace with compact demonstrations, explicit input feedback, and smooth joint-space motion. Three limited joint sliders and an explicit target calculate/select/move-or-apply workflow share one robot state, live endpoint coordinates, joint summaries, and the final tool-to-world matrix. Color and shape decisions come from the Qt stylesheet and the mechanical arm scene. The north star is a descriptive name for that existing direction, not a new identity proposal.
keyCharacteristics: Viewport-led composition with an adjustable, scrollable sidebar.
Dark tonal surfaces, restrained mint emphasis, and readable text.
Small corner radii, readable joint values, and immediate native interaction feedback.
Explicit calculation, selection, motion or instant application, and positioning-error feedback for inverse kinematics.
Fixed sidebar transport with speed, progress, pause/resume, stop, and immediate reset.
Compact preset loading, persistent mode context, and keyboard-accessible validation feedback.

rules.name: The Reserved Accent Rule
rules.body: Use mint emphasis for focus, actionable hover feedback, joint values, live coordinates, slider progress, selected tabs, and positioning-error feedback; keep general shell surfaces neutral. Coordinate-axis shafts retain PyVista's conventional colors; their labels use the scene-caption token.

rules.name: The Quiet Shell Rule
rules.body: Convey shell structure through surface tone, spacing, and borders so the scene retains visual priority.

dos: Do keep the viewport dominant and supporting information organized in the sidebar and results frame.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, signed joint limits, degree values, camera guidance, and the distinct Reset arm and Reset view behaviors.
Do keep live coordinates and matrix values synchronized with the arm, state millimetres and frame direction, and preserve text selection and clipboard export.
Do preserve the explicit calculate/select/move-or-apply workflow, target invalidation, positioning feedback, and coral-target/gold-endpoint distinction.
Do keep motion transport visible, distinguish Animate from Apply now, and retain immediate Reset arm.
Do use native Qt layout behavior and the established surface and typography tokens.
donts: Don't present placeholder rows as working inputs or show fabricated calculation values.
Don't add decorative shadows, instrument-panel ornament, or competing shell accents.
Don't move the arm during calculation, apply invalid or stale solutions, or imply collision avoidance, independent orientation control, Cartesian planning, or physical dynamics.
Don't substitute browser layouts or web component libraries for the native Qt interface.
